exclusions.body: each body is the test's 16 KiB (or tiny) JSON; the replay sends a request of the same size class through the Rust codec, so a body is compared as gzip-of-the-request or the request itself
exclusions.compressFailure: :137 injects a throwing compressor; the Rust gzip lane has no injection point
exclusions.countTokens: :48 also sends /v1/messages/count_tokens; the Rust adapter has no count_tokens send
exclusions.headersInstance: :38 is the fetch `Headers` object (no counterpart: headers are a list)
exclusions.offThread: :156 asserts the compressor is awaited off the main thread; the Rust compressor is a CPU-lane job by construction
exclusions.providerWiring: :74 custom-name and gateway Messages engines: Rust builds them as an HttpAdapter that never compresses (registry/builder.rs custom_messages_engine); the official and custom-base adapters are replayed here
exclusions.sseFraming: the test regions are written with Anthropic content_block_delta payloads so the Rust decoder (its consumer) yields them as text
